articles.title: The 13 best electrolyte powders of 2026, according to doctors and nutritionists
articles.summary: Experts share the best electrolyte powders for fast hydration and recovery, from brands like Liquid IV, Body Armor and DripDrop.
articles.body: Drinking plenty of water is essential to staying hydrated, but sometimes, H20 alone doesn’t cut it, says Dr. Matthew Sedgley, a physician specializing in sports medicine at MedStar Health. Those who do strenuous exercise, have a labor-intensive job or spend long periods in the heat may also need to replenish their electrolytes. “Electrolyte is a fancy word for minerals like sodium, potassium and magnesium, and they’re substances our bodies need to function,” he says. “Your body uses them as you do physical activity, which makes replacing them important.” Mixing electrolyte powder into your water is a fast and convenient way to do that, says Amy Goldsmith, a registered dietitian specializing in sports nutrition who owns Kindred Nutrition & Kinetics. These powders often come in pre-measured packets, so you know exactly how much of each mineral you’re getting, and they’re available in various flavors, so they taste good. I talked to doctors and nutritionists about how to shop for electrolyte powders, as well as who should (and shouldn’t) use them. But remember: Before you take anything, be sure to consult your doctor. Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter. Electrolyte powder 101 Before buying electrolyte powder, it’s helpful to understand what it is, what benefits it offers and who it’s designed for. Here’s some key information experts want you to know. The best electrolyte powders of 2026 Below, I rounded up electrolyte powders I’ve tried or experts recommend. I included the amount of sodium and potassium each one has per serving since they’re the most important minerals to look for while shopping, experts say. When adding powder to water, don't forget to give it a good stir — if you don’t, the powder won’t fully dissolve into your water, and you may end up sipping salty clumps. Try using a shaker bottle or a handheld electric mixer to thoroughly incorporate the powder into water if needed. Best tasting Goldsmith recommends Body Armor’s electrolyte powders over the brand’s pre-mixed beverages for hydration because they have less sugar and more sodium: One packet of the powder has 510 milligrams of sodium and zero grams of sugar, while one pre-mixed beverage has 30 milligrams of sodium and 29 grams of sugar. I’m also a big fan of this electrolyte powder, which the brand sent me to try. Its flavor isn’t overpowering or too sweet, and beyond sodium and potassium, it’s made with chloride, calcium and magnesium. I love the tropical punch flavor, and it’s available in options like lemon-lime and strawberry. Best tablets “Some brands offer electrolyte tablets rather than powders, which tend to be less messy,” says Jones. “The tabs dissolve in water and usually come in a small tube that’s easy to keep on hand while you’re on the go.” In my experience, electrolyte tablets take a bit longer than powders because you can’t mix them — you have to wait until the tablet completely dissolves on its own before drinking. I’ve used Nuun’s electrolyte tablets for years. They make your water fizzy when they dissolve, which I find is more enjoyable to drink. The tablets have sodium, potassium, magnesium, calcium and chloride, plus they’re gluten-free and vegan. You can buy Nuun’s electrolyte tablets in flavors like strawberry lemonade (my favorite), watermelon and tri–berry. They’re also eligible to buy with a flexible spending account (FSA). Best flavor selection Liquid IV, which Goldsmith recommends, is one of the most well-known brands in the electrolyte powder space. It comes in over a dozen flavors like lemon lime, strawberry and concord grape, so you’ll likely find one you like. Each pack has 11 grams of sugar, which I find gives it a very sweet taste, so I tend to dilute it with a few more ounces of water than the brand recommends. Liquid IV’s sodium- and potassium-based electrolyte powder is vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free. Best for beginners DripDrop’s variety of flavors is similar to Liquid IV’s, but the formula has lower sodium and sugar concentrations. That gives it a less pronounced taste, so I find it ideal for those who’ve never tried an electrolyte powder before and are getting used to drinking it. The powder is made with sodium, potassium and magnesium, and its formula is gluten-free and vegan. You can buy flavors like fruit punch, orange, lemon-lime and berry. Best balanced formula This electrolyte powder’s formula has a 2:1 ratio of sodium to potassium, which Goldsmith aims for when choosing a well-balanced product for her clients. It’s also third-party tested and Informed Choice Certified for purity and safety. The powder is made with calcium and magnesium and is free from artificial sweeteners, artificial coloring, dyes and gluten. You can buy flavors like raspberry lemonade and tropical punch. In addition to single-serve packets, Transparent Labs’ Hydrate electrolyte powder comes in a jar with a scooper. Make sure you level off the scoop before mixing with water, says Reavis. If you don’t, the electrolyte concentration may be slightly greater than what’s listed on the product’s nutrition label. Best sugar-free Because I find Liquid IV’s standard electrolyte powder very sweet, I prefer the brand’s sugar-free sodium- and potassium-based formula. Instead of cane sugar or artificial sweeteners, it’s made with allulose, a natural sugar found in fruit like figs and raisins. My favorite flavors are lemon-lime and white peach, which taste especially refreshing in ice water. Liquid IV’s sugar-free, vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free electrolyte powder also comes in flavors like raspberry melon, green grape and mandarin orange. Best sports drink alternative Gatorade’s electrolyte powder, which many experts recommend, has an ingredient profile that’s similar to its Gatorlyte sports drink. The powder is a great option if you like the taste of Gatorade but want the convenience of a single-serve packet you can throw in your gym bag. You can buy the powder, made with sodium, potassium, calcium, magnesium and chloride, in flavors like cherry lime, orange and watermelon. Best for athletes If you want a slightly sweet taste and fewer added carbohydrates than a sports drink, “Thorne Catalyte is a great option, and it’s also NSF Certified for Sport,” says Jones. “With 485 milligrams of sodium and five grams of carbohydrate, it’s perfect for active individuals.” Young also recommends this lemon-lime electrolyte powder, made with sodium, potassium, calcium, magnesium and chloride. Thorne Catalyte has no dairy, sugar, gluten or artificial flavors. Best for moderate exercise and active careers Since it has a moderate sodium concentration of 400 milligrams, Jones recommends Skratch Labs’ Hydration powder for those who have active careers, like construction workers, nurses, teachers and landscapers, and those who exercise for under an hour but tend to sweat a lot while doing so. The vegan powder is made with sodium, potassium, calcium and magnesium, and it’s gluten- and dairy-free. Skratch Labs’ electrolyte powder comes in flavors like pineapple, strawberry lemonade and orange. Best for intense exercise “For those with very high sweat rates, I often suggest incorporating LMNT to aid in rehydration and maintaining energy levels during exercise,” says Jones. LMNT’s vegan, gluten-free electrolyte powder has the highest sodium concentration out of all the options on this list at 1,000 milligrams, making it suitable for those engaged in prolonged intense physical activity, like marathon runners and long-distance bikers. Its formula has magnesium as well as sodium and potassium. You can buy the powder in flavors like citrus salt, watermelon salt, raspberry salt and mango chili salt. Best FSA-eligible Electrolyte replacement products that help prevent dehydration and don’t contain added supplements are eligible for reimbursement with an FSA, a health savings account (HSA) or a health reimbursement arrangement (HRA). Very few brands currently qualify, but Cure is one of them. Its 240 milligrams of sodium is a low concentration, which makes it a great option for first-timers. Cure sent me flavors likeberry pomegranate, watermelon, lemonade and strawberry kiwi to try, all of which tasted great and dissolved quickly when I stirred the powder into water. Most subtle flavor I often crave an intensely flavored beverage during workouts, but I can’t always stomach something super sweet or salty before I exercise. That’s when I use Moon Juice’s electrolyte powder, which the brand sent me to try. It helps me preload electrolytes before a long run or hot yoga class, but I barely taste the powder. Moon Juice’s Mini Dew electrolyte powder is sugar-free and made with sodium, potassium, calcium, magnesium and chloride. Moon Juice also offers a pomelo-flavored version. Best for when you're sick You lose electrolytes while you’re sick if you’re vomiting or having diarrhea, says Mallipattu. In those cases, he recommends drinking Pedialyte, available in powders or as a pre-mixed liquid solution. It has a very simple formula mainly composed of sodium, potassium and chloride, which is similar to what you’d get through IV fluids at the hospital, he says. How I picked the best electrolyte powders While shopping for electrolyte powders, experts recommend keeping the following in mind, all of which I took into consideration while curating a list of the best options. Mineral composition: An electrolyte powder’s nutrition label details what minerals it’s made with. Sodium and potassium are the most important minerals to look for because you lose them at the highest rates while sweating, says Jones. Some powders also contain electrolytes like calcium, magnesium, chloride and phosphorus, but they’re not as quickly depleted, so they’re less important from a hydration standpoint, she says.Mineral concentration: The nutrition label also tells you how much of each mineral the powder is made with, measured in milligrams. Formulas vary by brand. Overall, the right amount of each mineral for you depends on factors like your level of physical activity, sweat rate and health status, so talk to your doctor about what they recommend. As a baseline, experts break down their suggestions below.Sugar content: Many electrolyte powders contain sugar because it’s a carbohydrate that acts as fuel for your muscles and aids in fluid balance, says Goldsmith. Sugar is beneficial for the average healthy person engaging in strenuous physical activity for 90 minutes or longer, like marathon runners, says Sedgley. If that doesn’t sound like you, you can opt for a sugar-free electrolyte powder, if you prefer, says Reavis. Check the electrolyte powder’s nutrition label for information about the source and concentration of sugar, measured in grams. If you’re sensitive to sugar, consult your doctor about what’s best for your body. (Read more about sugar in electrolyte powers below.)Additional ingredients: Beyond electrolytes and sugar, some powders have other ingredients, like vitamin C and vitamin B. Read the nutrition label to make sure the powder doesn’t contain ingredients you need to avoid, whether that’s due to a health condition or because you’re getting plenty of it from another source, like a daily multivitamin, says Dr. Sandeep Mallipattu, a professor of medicine and the chief of the division of nephrology and hypertension at Stony Brook Medicine. Also make sure you don’t buy a powder made with caffeine. “Caffeine is a diuretic, which causes our body to lose water, and that’s the opposite of our goal with hydration,” says Reavis.Flavor: Electrolyte powders come in various flavors, some of which are more pronounced than others once you mix them with water. Try to avoid artificial coloring and flavoring agents if possible, says Jones. Also, remember that the more sodium in an electrolyte powder, the saltier it will taste, says Goldsmith. Third-party certifications: The FDA doesn’t regulate dietary supplements like electrolyte powders prior to them being sold. The agency is only responsible for regulating them after they’ve entered the market. However, companies can opt to have their products tested by agencies like the U.S. Pharmacopeia, Consumerlab.com and NSF International, says Patruno. These organizations give products their seal of approval, which is often reflected on packaging, so long as they meet potency, purity and quality requirements; contain the ingredients listed on their label in the stated amounts; and are free from contaminants. Elite athletes are often drug tested before competitions, so they must buy an electrolyte powder that’s NSF Certified for Sport or has the Informed Sport certification to ensure it’s free of banned substances, says Jones. How much electrolytes should you drink? The FDA sets Daily Value recommendations for amounts of certain nutrients you should not exceed each day, including electrolytes like sodium, potassium and calcium. However, these recommendations don’t account for how much of each mineral you lose and need to replace while doing physical activity, says Goldsmith. Use the FDA’s Daily Value recommendations as a guide while evaluating electrolyte powders’ nutrition labels, though these are generally based on 2,000 calories per day, which might be too high or too low for some people, says Patruno. Talk to a registered dietitian or your doctor about what’s right for you. Sodium Sodium is the most important mineral to prioritize when buying an electrolyte powder since you lose it at the highest rate while sweating, says Jones. However, how much sodium you need depends on your activity level, sweat rate and overall health status. Below, experts share their recommendations for sodium concentration in electrolyte powder, but consult your doctor to determine what’s best for you. 200 milligrams of sodium: Someone who engages in moderate physical activity for an hour or less, or works a job that requires them to be on their feet all day.500 milligrams of sodium: Someone who engages in moderate to intense physical activity for over an hour, works a labor-intensive job and/or spends an extended period of time outdoors in the heat.1,0000 milligrams of sodium: Someone who engages in prolonged intense physical activity, like marathoner runners, long-distance bikers and those playing team sports.Over 1,000 milligrams of sodium: Don’t take an electrolyte powder with over 1,000 milligrams of sodium unless you’re directed to by a medical professional. For example, a nutritionist may recommend one of these highly concentrated powders for elite athletes competing in events like Ironman Triathlons, says Jones. Potassium After sodium, pay attention to potassium since it’s the mineral you lose at the second highest rate through sweat, says Jones. Many electrolyte powders have a 2:1 ratio of sodium to potassium, like 500 milligrams of sodium to 250 milligrams of potassium, for example. High sodium intake with insufficient potassium can quickly increase blood pressure, but a balanced 2:1 ratio helps prevent that from happening as the electrolytes move through the cells, says Sedgley. Other minerals Some electrolyte powders contain additional minerals like calcium, chloride, magnesium and phosphorus. They’re less important from a hydration standpoint, so don’t worry about them unless your doctor advises you to, says Jones. Why is there sugar in electrolyte powder? When you do over an hour of intense exercise like running or biking, your body uses sugar, a carbohydrate, as fuel for your muscles, says Goldsmith. Sugar also helps with fluid balance and masks the salty taste of electrolytes, she says. Because of this, many electrolyte powders have 10 to 20 grams of added sugar per serving. “In terms of athletic performance, we think of sugar in an electrolyte powder differently than added sugar in regular food,” says Goldsmith. “This amount of added sugar per serving could be considered excessive if you’re sedentary and eat a lot of foods with added sugars, but from an exercise perspective, it’s necessary for your muscles.” That said, it’s important to think about your daily sugar intake to properly assess your needs, so consult your doctor. Electrolyte powders are made with different types of sugar, including natural sugars like honey and agave, cane sugar and artificial sweeteners like stevia and xylitol. Each type of sugar has a different flavor and glycemic index, meaning how quickly it raises blood sugar levels after you eat it. The average healthy person doesn’t have to think much about the type of sugar in an electrolyte powder and can prioritize their taste preferences, says Young. But if you have a medical condition like diabetes and need to be careful about sugar consumption, consult your doctor about what’s best for your body. Young also says that artificial sweeteners tend to give some people an upset stomach, so consider avoiding them if you have a history of gastrointestinal issues. When should you drink electrolyte powder? There’s no perfect time to drink electrolyte powder. Everybody is different, so figuring out what’s right for you involves some trial and error, as well as consulting your doctor. Drinking electrolyte powder about two hours before physical activity ensures your body has an ample supply available, so when you start sweating and losing electrolytes, you don’t get depleted quickly, says Reavis. Preloading electrolytes is especially important if you’re doing physical activity outdoors in the heat for an extended period. High temperatures exacerbate sweating and, therefore, electrolyte loss, which puts you more at risk for quick depletion, says Reavis.Drinking electrolyte powder during physical activity helps you constantly replenish your supply so you don’t hit a point where you’re running on empty, says Reavis.Drinking electrolyte powder after physical activity can help build your supply back up after you’ve used everything available, says Reavis. However, your body needs electrolytes most when you’re actively sweating, so drinking them after physical activity isn’t typically the most beneficial, he says. Overall, “hydration is a lot like pain management,” says Goldsmith, “Once you’re behind, it’s really hard to get ahead of it.” That said, ensure you’re drinking enough water daily, regardless of whether you’re adding electrolyte powder. Who should not use electrolyte powder? Suppose you don’t engage in much physical activity during your day-to-day life and aren’t heavily sweating. In that case, you can likely get plenty of electrolytes from a healthy, balanced diet, says Reavis, so electrolyte powder is unnecessary. However, some people find that adding a small amount of flavored electrolyte powder to their water — like half a packet or less — encourages them to drink. So, as long as you consult your doctor and choose an electrolyte powder with a low amount of sodium (200 mg to 300 mg.), do what works for you, says Reavis. Additionally, a few groups of people need to be extra cautious when it comes to using electrolyte powder, making it even more important to work closely with a doctor to find the right option: Anybody with a cardiovascular condition. Consuming high sodium levels may lead to fluid retention, which can be dangerous for those with heart conditions that make it hard for the body to get rid of water, says Sedgley.Anybody with a kidney condition that makes it hard for the body to get rid of excess electrolytes, says Sedgley. If you’re prone to kidney stones, pay close attention to how much vitamin C is in the powder you’re considering — in excess amounts, it can lead to kidney stone formation, says Mallipattu. Children, who should not drink electrolyte powder unless they’re directed to by a doctor since most products are created for adults, says Sedgley. What is an electrolyte imbalance? An electrolyte imbalance occurs when there’s either too many or insufficient electrolytes in your body, says Sedgley. Some symptoms of an electrolyte imbalance overlap with those of dehydration, and you can experience both conditions simultaneously — overall, however, they’re different from one another. Dehydration has to do with water loss, while an electrolyte imbalance has to do with being deficient or abundant in certain minerals, says Mallipattu. (If you’re concerned about experiencing dehydration and/or an electrolyte imbalance, consult your doctor.) An electrolyte imbalance can present differently depending on the minerals your body has too much or too little of, says Mallipattu. If you’re low or high in sodium, for example, you may experience symptoms like confusion or an unstable gait, he says. If you’re low in potassium, you may experience muscle weakness and cramps or, in more severe cases, heart arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat), says Mallipattu. Hyponatremia, a condition that occurs when there’s not enough sodium in your blood, is one of the main types of electrolyte depletion Sedgley sees during marathons and similar physically demanding events. “If someone stopped at every water station on the course and they’ve drunk too much, plus they’re sweating out salt, they may have diluted the sodium in their blood,” he says, noting that symptoms of hyponatremia include muscle cramps, nausea, headaches, confusion and fatigue. How does electrolyte powder compare to other electrolyte products? Beyond electrolyte powder, brands make electrolyte drops, chews, gels and pre-mixed drinks like Gatorade and Powerade. Each product offers its own set of benefits, but for the most part, they’re variations on the same theme, so choosing one is a matter of personal preference. However, keep in mind that electrolyte products can differ in their average mineral concentration, which impacts how much one serving can help boost your hydration levels. “You can’t get as high of a concentration in one serving of an electrolyte drop or chew as you can get in a powder,” says Goldsmith. “That means you usually have to use more of those other products more often.” Some people also use different electrolyte products depending on the situation. Chews or gels, for instance, are typically easier for runners to fit in their fanny packs and quickly take during a race. But those who play sports like baseball or soccer can keep a water bottle on the sidelines and mix in powders. Does electrolyte powder help with a hangover? Yes, to some degree, drinking electrolyte powder can help with a hangover, says Mallipattu. “You often end up urinating a lot if you drink a lot of alcohol, so you lose water and some sodium,” he says. “Therefore the electrolytes do make a difference, but eating a salty meal may help as well.” Meet our wellness experts At NBC Selected, we work with experts who have specialized knowledge and authority based on relevant training and/or experience. We also take steps to ensure that all expert advice and recommendations are made independently and with no undisclosed financial conflicts of interest. Dr. Matthew Sedgley is a physician who specializes in sports medicine at MedStar Health.Dr. Sandeep Mallipattu is a professor of medicine and the chief of the division of nephrology and hypertension at Stony Brook Medicine.Kelly Jones is a sports dietitian who works with professional and student athletes (MS, RD, CSSD).Amy Goldsmith is a registered dietitian who specializes in sports nutrition and owns Kindred Nutrition & Kinetics (RD, LDN). She's also a dietician at WOW MD.Michael Reavis Jr. is a clinical dietitian at the University of Maryland Medical Center (MS, RD, LDN).Jay Patruno is a registered dietitian and certified personal trainer (MS, RDN, LDN, CPT, CNC).Lisa Young is a registered nutritionist and an adjunct professor of nutrition at New York University (Ph.D, RDN). Why trust NBC Selected? I’m a reporter at NBC Selected who writes about health and wellness, including articles on KN95 masks, sunburn treatments, at-home Covid tests and ingrown hair treatments. For this article, I interviewed seven doctors and nutritionists about how to shop for the best electrolyte powder. Experts recommended some of their favorite options, and I also included products I’ve tried. Catch up on NBC Selected’s in-depth coverage of tech and tools, wellness and more, and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, X and TikTok to stay up to date.

articles.title: I’ve tested nearly a dozen point-and-shoot cameras — these are the best no matter your experience level
articles.summary: I tested nearly a dozen point-and-shoot cameras from Kodak, Fujifilm, Sony, Leica, and Ricoh to find the perfect balance of size and quality.
articles.body: Pocketable point-and-shoot cameras are having a serious moment. New and old models are selling out, with most camera manufacturers struggling to keep up with demand. The Fujifilm X100VI, a very popular camera on social media, took me five months to receive after placing my pre-order. As a tech reporter (and a photography enthusiast), I test cameras year-round — I’ve tried over a dozen cameras to get. Below are some of the best point-and-shoot cameras, plus expert advice about what makes these cameras worthwhile. Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter. The best point-and-shoot cameras in 2026 My top picks come from camera brands like Sony, Leica and Ricoh. Some options on this list were sent to me by the brands for testing purposes for this story, others were not. I list key specifications I think you should know below each recommendation. If you find any of them confusing, you can learn more about the basics of photography, including terms like aperture, shutter speed and ISO, on sites like Adobe, MasterClass, Skillshare, and Expert Photography. Best overall This is one of the highest quality, most fully-featured compact cameras on the market. It is also one of the most coveted — I received mine five months after I placed my pre-order. It has the largest and most detailed image sensor on our list (by far), and can capture incredibly sharp, detailed photos. This is made easy with the advanced auto-focus system — the camera uses AI-based subject detection to automatically focus on birds, animals, cars and even the individual eyes of a person’s face. The built-in image stabilization also means your shaky hands are less likely to cause blurry photos. It has multiple dials and switches for precise control over your photography and videography. One of my favorite settings is the 20 Fujifilm film simulation modes, which are essentially “looks” with their own color, saturation, shadow detail and other settings to mimic the look of literal Fuji film. The list of useful features goes on and on and on, but the camera does have a few limitations. The Fujifilm X100VI is the largest and heaviest camera on our list — I can fit it in large coat pockets, not a pants pocket. It also does not have a zoom lens. Both make it less flexible as a travel camera than our picks from Sony and Leica. You can learn more in my Fujifilm X100VI review. Best budget If you are looking to spend under $200, but want something with more control than an instant camera, consider this budget Kodak camera. Former NBC Selected associate reporter Bianca Alvarez took the Pixpro FZ55 abroad — it was so small and lightweight that she brought it everywhere without a second thought. It has a smaller sensor that lacks detail compared to our other picks, but it is one of the most affordable point-and-shoot cameras on the market. It also makes for a good gift to anyone looking to try out photography. Just note that it won’t perform very well in low-light environments. Best zoom Anyone looking for a compact camera that takes high-quality photos and doesn’t skimp on features should consider the Sony RX100 VII. NBC News associate art director Kara Birnbaum says this is the best point-and-shoot camera she has ever used. The images look crisp and clean, even in dark lighting, especially compared to similarly compact cameras from Panasonic and Kodak. Plus, the small size makes it easy for Birnbaum to bring it with her everywhere and snap photos when inspiration strikes — something that’s harder to do with her other cameras. If this sounds like your dream camera but is out of your budget, consider the Sony ZV-1 as an alternative — it is more streamlined for taking videos, not photos, but has a similar design and controls. Best compact camera Former NBC Selected commerce editor Jordan Bowman has taken some of his best photos with Ricoh GR cameras — he brings one almost everywhere. After all, the best camera is the one you have with you. It takes sharper, more detailed photos than nearly all of our other recommendations (except the Fujifilm X100VI). Much of that image quality is because of this camera’s large sensor, which captures more sharp detail and a wider range of light and shadows than our picks from Sony, Leica, Kodak and Panasonic. That image quality comes at a cost — the camera has a fixed lens that cannot zoom in or out. But the fixed lens has a wide field of view that’s great for street photography and snapshot style photos, says Bowman. Best for video While it looks like a regular point-and-shoot camera, the Canon Powershot V1 is a video camera at heart, with features largely focused on easily capturing video content. It has easy to understand touch screen controls (along with dials and buttons), snappy autofocus and an included microphone cover that helps muffle wind noise. While it’s centered on video, it’s a decent photo camera too, especially for the price. Its larger- than-average image sensor means more detailed shots than many competitors (including our Kodak and Panasonic picks). Plus, unlike many cameras on this list, it has been consistently in-stock online since its launch in April 2025. Best toy camera Let me be clear: The Kodak Charmera does not take “good” photos. They are often blurry and not very detailed. But this camera is more about the fun in using it than the quality of the photos. It’s a conversation starter and a great party activity: not something to pour your photographic talent into. It’s absolutely tiny (smaller than Apple AirPods): you can attach it to a key ring using the built-in loop on the side of the camera. It takes photos, videos, has a few filter effects and a tiny built-in flash. It comes in seven styles, but you can’t pick which one you’ll get: it’s a blind box where you don’t know what you’ll get until you open it. Best superzoom If you want to photograph subjects at a distance — think wildlife or architectural details, but don’t want to lug around a big camera, this is the model to get. It has an incredible zoom range of 720 millimeters, over triple that of the Sony RX100 VII. Plus it has image stabilization built-in to help mitigate camera shake, especially when zoomed in on far-off subjects. I’ve tested previous models in the Lumix ZS series, and found them to deliver a good mix of image quality, ease of use and portability. While image quality can’t compete with our picks from Sony and Leica, neither zoom nearly as far as the Lumix ZS99 does. Best splurge Editor’s note: I’m testing the Panasonic Lumix L10 . I may update this pick after I finish testing. The Leica D-Lux 8 is probably my favorite camera on this list. I love the sleek design, precise manual controls and short but useful zoom range, but it’s the pictures I took that won me over. The larger than average image sensor delivers some remarkable shots that rival photos I’ve taken on much larger mirrorless cameras. It has a robust automatic mode, but I found myself tinkering with the many clicky dials to lock-in my exposure and create more thought-out images. The same cannot be said for most other point-and-shoot cameras I’ve tried. It’s pricier and less pocketable than most of our other top picks. It also does not have a built-in flash, but it does come with a small flash unit you can slot into the top of the camera. Staff-favorite More than 10 NBC Selected staffers tested the original Camp Snap camera, and it instantly won our hearts because of how easy it is to use and how fun it is to shoot with. It’s modeled after an old-school disposable point-and-shoot film camera: There are no settings to change, no screen to look at, it’s just a viewfinder, flash and a shutter button. The little LCD screen on the back also tells you how many photos you’ve taken — that’s it. The colorful, textured material on the front of the camera is attractive but also helps with grip, and there is a small thumb imprint on the back of the camera which helps you hold it as the camera is very rectangular. The Camp Snap 2 improves upon the original in every way. You can now change between six built-in color filters with the button on the back, and the on-off switch and shutter button are now separate, which makes turning it on and off and actually taking photos much more responsive than on the original. Unfortunately, the photos are still largely hit or miss. Our favorites were either taken outdoors with an abundance of light or inside with the flash on. You can learn more in my Camp Snap camera review. For underwater adventure If you need a durable camera that you can use in basically any environment, Mark Steinberg, the senior technologist at B&H Photo & Video, recommends the Olympus TG series. This TG-7 is the latest model and its designed for extreme conditions — you can use it underwater up to about 50 feet, according to the brand. Plus it’s shockproof up to seven feet and crushproof, able to resist up to 220 pounds of force. Upgrades from the previous TG-6 include a more color-accurate screen, a ribbed plastic texture around the grip, USB-C charging and more. There is a tradeoff to its small size and durable build — it has a smaller, less detailed sensor compared to many of our top picks. What is a point-and-shoot camera? A point-and-shoot digital camera is typically small and compact, with a built-in lens and features like automatic photo and video modes, according to our experts. This is different from DSLR and mirrorless cameras, which can range in size and weight and have larger, removable lenses. I focus on small and compact point-and-shoot cameras in this guide, but there are other kinds on the market too, including “super zoom” models with longer, bulkier lenses. How I picked the best point-and-shoot cameras To pick the best point-and-shoot cameras on the market, I tried models from brands like Canon, Sony, Fujifilm, Kodak and Panasonic throughout the year. Then, to learn more about cameras and current trends, I spoke with Steinberg (note: B&H Photo & Video is one of the biggest camera stores in the U.S) and chose cameras based on the following criteria: Portability: A point and shoot camera is at its best when it fits easily into your pocket or bag. Nearly all of our top picks weigh less than a pound, and fit into most jacket pockets.Control: A good point-and-shoot camera lets you do just that: point and shoot. I paid close attention to how each camera felt to control, especially its buttons, dials and screen interface.Zoom: Most point-and-shoot cameras have optical zoom lenses that can punch in to far distances without the digital compression of a smartphone or bulk of a traditional camera. I took photos of subjects close up and far away, and noted ease of use and image quality. How to shop for a point-and-shoot camera Cameras, even within a sub-category like point-and-shoot, can vary in shape, size and function. The Om System Tough TG-7 and Panasonic Lumix ZS99 may have a similar price tag, but they look, feel and function very differently. Below are a few things our experts recommend keeping in mind as you shop for your next camera. What are you looking to photograph? A camera that’s great for taking family portraits may not also be great at photographing far-off wildlife. Before you purchase any camera, it’s important to understand what you are looking to photograph or film. If you want to shoot photos of wildlife, look for a camera with a long zoom range — professional wildlife lenses typically have a minimum zoom length of at least 200mm, according to B&H Photo & Video. If you plan on mostly shooting video, consider choosing a camera with a flip-up screen that makes it easier to film yourself, and one that can shoot video in a 4K resolution. If you love the detail of a sunset or texture of flower petals, look for a camera with a larger image sensor, it’s going to capture those details with more clarity, in my experience. How does it feel to use the camera? I’ve tested enough cameras to know that sometimes it’s all about feel. Some cameras feel great in my hands, some don’t. Before purchasing your next camera, consider shopping in-person so you can physically hold and test your options, says Steinberg. Meet our photography experts At NBC Selected, we work with experts who have specialized knowledge and authority based on relevant training and/or experience. We also take steps to ensure all expert advice and recommendations are made independently and without undisclosed financial conflicts of interest. Mark Steinberg is the senior technologist at B&H Photo & Video. He has decades of experience in camera and electronic sales. (B&H Photo sells hundreds of cameras, and Steinberg does not have affiliations with any individual camera brand).Kara Birnbaum is a commerce photo editor at NBC News. She photographs and produces commercial stock imagery for NBC Selected, CNBC Select, Shop Today and MSNBC. Why trust NBC Selected? Harry Rabinowitz is a former reporter at NBC Selected who covered technology and fitness including tories on fitness trackers, walking shoes and wireless earbuds. He tests new point-and-shoot cameras year-round, and spoke with other NBC Selected team members about their experiences with cameras they use frequently. articles.title: FBI advised ESPN star Pat McAfee to wear a bulletproof vest after Charlie Kirk’s assassination
articles.summary: The FBI advised Pat McAfee to wear a bulletproof vest after the Charlie Kirk assassination, a source says, as safety fears grow for media figures.
articles.body:
The FBI advised ESPN commentator Pat McAfee to begin wearing a bulletproof vest the week after the assassination of Charlie Kirk last year, a source familiar with the situation told OutKick.

McAfee alluded to Kirk earlier this week while explaining why he did not feel safe filming "College GameDay" on the Utah Valley University campus.

"And then I thought to myself, has anything like really scary happened at like a college gathering in the state of Utah recently?" McAfee said Monday during his show. "Like, do we think we should be amplifying reasons for why people hate my guts as a university? I don't know."

Front Office Sports first reported the FBI's advice to McAfee.

ESPN released a statement that it takes all threats seriously, adding, "We support Pat and recognize the very real and valid concerns he has around safety and security."

It is unclear what specifically caused McAfee to feel unsafe on campus. However, an official university account posted a viral video that students used to mock McAfee as "corny" for ripping his shirt off on campus during "College GameDay."

Kirk's assassination in 2025 has raised concerns among polarizing media figures about their safety in public.

McAfee, arguably the biggest star in sports media, is frequently the target of hysteria and false accusations from internet users, especially after his interview with President Trump on ESPN earlier this year.

He appears weekly on ESPN's "College GameDay," which airs live from a college campus.

McAfee did not respond to a text message from OutKick seeking comment on the FBI's advice by the time of publication.

We will update this story if he provides an on-the-record statement.

articles.title: Porto de Natal recebe licença para dragagem no Rio Potengi | G1
articles.standfirst: Obra prevê a retirada de até 1,4 milhão de metros cúbicos de sedimentos do Rio Potengi. Objetivo é permitir a entrada de navios maiores e ampliar a capacidade de transporte de cargas.
articles.summary: A dragagem no Porto de Natal vai aprofundar o Rio Potengi para 12,5 metros, permitindo manobras de navios maiores e ampliando a capacidade de transporte de cargas.
articles.body:
Porto de Natal, Rio Grande do Norte — Foto: Sandro Menezes/Assecom

O Instituto de Desenvolvimento Sustentável e Meio Ambiente do Rio Grande do Norte (Idema) concedeu à Companhia Docas do Estado (Codern) uma licença ambiental para a dragagem de uma área usada nas manobras de navios no Porto de Natal . O documento foi assinado na terça-feira (27).

A obra prevê a retirada de até 1,4 milhão de metros cúbicos de sedimentos do fundo do Rio Potengi. O objetivo é aprofundar a área conhecida como bacia de evolução, onde os navios fazem manobras para se posicionar antes de atracar no cais.

Segundo a Codern, a intervenção deve permitir a operação de navios maiores e ampliar a capacidade de transporte de cargas pelo porto. A licença estabelece que a área dragada alcance uma profundidade de 12,5 metros.

O diretor-presidente da Codern, Paulo Henrique Macedo, afirmou que a companhia ainda vai definir o cronograma da obra com a empresa responsável pela execução. “Isso vai permitir o aumento do comprimento dos navios [que atracam no porto], além de consolidar a segurança do nosso canal e da bacia de evolução”, disse.

A licença estabelece medidas para acompanhar possíveis impactos da dragagem. Entre elas estão o monitoramento da qualidade da água, dos sedimentos e dos organismos aquáticos, além do controle da turbidez — quando partículas em suspensão deixam a água mais turva.

Também deverão ser acompanhadas a área onde o material retirado será descartado e a região da Praia da Redinha e arredores, para identificar possíveis alterações na dinâmica costeira.

O documento prevê ainda medidas para reduzir riscos à fauna marinha, incluindo tartarugas e cetáceos, grupo que reúne baleias e golfinhos.

A Codern também deverá disponibilizar um canal de comunicação para pescadores artesanais e comunidades da área de influência da obra. A licença prevê ainda uma consulta à colônia de pescadores da região.

De acordo com a Codern, a dragagem do canal de acesso ao Porto de Natal já foi concluída. A nova etapa será feita na bacia de evolução, área utilizada pelos navios para manobrar antes de atracar.

O diretor administrativo e financeiro da companhia, Hugo Alexandre Meneses Fonseca, afirmou que a articulação do governo estadual em Brasília ajudou na obtenção de recursos federais para a obra.

Segundo o diretor-geral do Idema, Werner Farkatt, o processo de análise ambiental levou cerca de quatro meses entre a entrada do pedido e a conclusão do licenciamento.

articles.title: 'PixMEI' de até R$ 5 mil: o que é, como funciona e quem pode receber | G1
articles.standfirst: Proposta prevê benefício não reembolsável para MEIs investirem nos negócios, com prioridade para mulheres empreendedoras e trabalhadores com faturamento anual de até R$ 40,5 mil.
articles.summary: Proposta prevê benefício não reembolsável para MEIs investirem nos negócios, com prioridade para mulheres empreendedoras e trabalhadores com faturamento anual de até R$ 40,5 mil.
articles.body:
O MEI deve fazer a declaração Anual do Simples Nacional (DASN-SIMEI) — Foto: Divulgação/Sebrae

Na última quarta-feira (21), foi sancionada a lei que perdoa dívidas de microempreendedores individuais (MEIs), amplia o limite de faturamento da categoria e permite a contratação de mais funcionários.

Entre o pacote de benefícios para MEIs e pequenos negócios lançado pelo governo federal, está o PixMEI, uma proposta de incentivo financeiro de até R$ 5 mil para microempreendedores individuais (MEIs) investirem em seus negócios .

O dinheiro será concedido a fundo perdido, ou seja, sem necessidade de devolução e sem cobrança de juros . O recurso deverá ser usado na compra de máquinas, equipamentos e ferramentas profissionais, além de melhorias na estrutura do negócio.

A proposta prevê prioridade para mulheres empreendedoras e MEIs com faturamento anual de até R$ 40,5 mil. A iniciativa integra o pacote ProsperaMEI e ainda está em fase de elaboração.

A previsão é que o programa seja executado entre 2027 e 2030 , mas as regras definitivas e o cronograma de inscrições ainda precisam ser divulgados.

O PixMEI é uma proposta de apoio financeiro direto a microempreendedores individuais. A ideia é oferecer um capital inicial de até R$ 5 mil para que os trabalhadores possam investir em seus pequenos negócios sem precisar recorrer a empréstimos bancários.

Diferentemente das linhas de crédito tradicionais, o benefício será não reembolsável . Isso significa que, conforme a proposta, o beneficiário não precisará devolver o dinheiro ao governo nem pagar juros pelo valor recebido.

A iniciativa tem como objetivo ampliar a capacidade produtiva dos pequenos negócios, permitindo que os empreendedores adquiram equipamentos e melhorem a estrutura de trabalho.

A proposta prevê que o dinheiro seja destinado a investimentos que contribuam para o desenvolvimento da atividade econômica. Entre as possibilidades estão:

Compra de bancadas e outros itens necessários ao trabalho;

Reforma e adaptação de veículos utilitários e de entrega, conforme as regras que serão definidas.

A seleção dos participantes e o acompanhamento dos projetos deverão contar com a participação do Serviço Brasileiro de Apoio às Micro e Pequenas Empresas (Sebrae), que poderá oferecer orientação técnica aos empreendedores.

O governo ainda precisa detalhar como será feita a inscrição , quais documentos serão exigidos, como os projetos serão avaliados e de que maneira o dinheiro será liberado.

Quem poderá receber os R$ 5 mil do PixMEI?

A proposta prevê atendimento a microempreendedores individuais, com prioridade para mulheres empreendedoras e MEIs com faturamento anual de até R$ 40,5 mil .

O planejamento inicial menciona o atendimento de cerca de 1 milhão de microempreendedores . No entanto, os critérios definitivos de participação, as regras de seleção e a quantidade de beneficiários ainda precisam ser confirmados oficialmente pelo governo federal.

Por enquanto, não é possível afirmar que todos os MEIs terão direito ao benefício . A concessão dependerá das condições que serão estabelecidas pelo governo.

Ainda não há data confirmada para o lançamento do PixMEI nem para a abertura das inscrições.

A expectativa inicial era de que o edital fosse apresentado até o fim de 2026, mas o cronograma oficial ainda precisa ser confirmado . A previsão é que a execução da iniciativa ocorra entre 2027 e 2030 , de acordo com o Ministério do Empreendedorismo.

Até a divulgação das regras oficiais, não há inscrições abertas nem prazo para solicitar os recursos. Os interessados devem acompanhar os comunicados do Ministério do Empreendedorismo e as orientações sobre a participação no programa.

O planejamento divulgado prevê alcançar aproximadamente 1 milhão de microempreendedores, com investimentos produtivos que podem chegar a R$ 5 bilhões , segundo o Ministério do Empreendedorismo, da Microempresa e da Empresa de Pequeno Porte.

A execução dependerá da regulamentação e da divulgação das condições oficiais do programa.

O PixMEI é a única medida do pacote ProsperaMEI que ainda está em fase de elaboração , segundo as informações apresentadas sobre a proposta.

articles.title: Presidente da AMM é reeleito por unanimidade para mais três anos | G1
articles.standfirst: Hemerson Máximo recebeu os 111 votos dos prefeitos que participaram da eleição para a diretoria da associação, em Cuiabá.
articles.summary: Hemerson Máximo recebeu os 111 votos dos prefeitos que participaram da eleição para a diretoria da associação, em Cuiabá.
articles.body:
Presidente da Associação Mato-grossense dos Municípios (AMM), Hemerson Lourenço Máximo — Foto: Reprodução

O presidente da Associação Mato-grossense dos Municípios (AMM), Hemerson Lourenço Máximo, conhecido como Maninho, foi reeleito para comandar a instituição no triênio 2027/2029. A apuração dos votos foi concluída nesta quarta-feira (28), na sede da entidade, em Cuiabá . Dos 142 prefeitos de Mato Grosso, 111 participaram da eleição e todos votaram na Chapa 1, intitulada AMM + Forte e Presente.

A votação garantiu a recondução de Maninho por unanimidade entre os participantes. Com a apuração e a proclamação do resultado, foi encerrado o processo eleitoral para a escolha da Diretoria Executiva e do Conselho Fiscal da associação.

A abertura das urnas foi conduzida pela Comissão Eleitoral, com a participação dos prefeitos de Matupá, Bruno Mena, e de Paranatinga , Antônio Marcos Tomazini . Antes da contagem, os integrantes conferiram os lacres das urnas.

Para a próxima gestão, a diretoria pretende dar continuidade ao trabalho em conjunto com os prefeitos, com foco na defesa dos interesses dos municípios, na busca por recursos e no diálogo com os poderes Executivo e Legislativo.

A proposta também inclui ampliar a presença da AMM nas diferentes regiões de Mato Grosso e fortalecer o suporte técnico oferecido às prefeituras. Entre as medidas previstas estão a ampliação das capacitações para prefeitos e equipes técnicas e o diálogo com os governos estadual e federal, além das bancadas parlamentares.

A votação começou em 16 de setembro, quando foram registrados 99 votos. Depois, uma votação complementar acrescentou outros 12 votos. As cédulas das duas etapas foram mantidas em urnas separadas e lacradas, conforme determinações judiciais.

A retomada dos trabalhos para a conclusão do processo eleitoral foi autorizada após a Justiça extinguir a ação relacionada à eleição. Nesta quarta-feira, a Comissão Eleitoral conferiu os lacres, abriu as urnas, realizou a contagem e consolidou o resultado.

O presidente da Comissão Eleitoral, Alexandre Lopes, prefeito de Campo Verde, informou que os procedimentos seguiram as normas legais e as regras previstas no estatuto da instituição.

A posse da nova diretoria está prevista para janeiro de 2027.

articles.title: Homem é preso com quase meia tonelada de maconha e carro roubado em MS | G1
articles.standfirst: Ação começou após policiais identificarem um carro com sinais de clonagem. Foram apreendidos 458 kg de maconha e 10 kg de skunk.
articles.summary: Ação começou após policiais identificarem um carro com sinais de clonagem. Foram apreendidos 458 kg de maconha e 10 kg de skunk.
articles.body:
Polícia prende homem com drogas e carro roubado na fronteira do Brasil com o Paraguai — Foto: PF/Reprodução

Um homem, que não teve a identidade divulgada, foi preso em flagrante pela Polícia Federal (PF), nesta quarta-feira (28), em Ponta Porã (MS), na fronteira do Brasil com o Paraguai. Durante a ação, os policiais apreenderam 468 kg de drogas e dois veículos. A operação começou após a identificação de um carro com sinais de clonagem.

Segundo a PF, um dos carros apresentava sinais de clonagem. No local, os policiais também encontraram um outro veículo com 458 kg de maconha.

No mesmo imóvel, os policiais também encontraram 10 kg de skunk, uma variedade mais potente da maconha.

Após consultar os sistemas policiais, a PF confirmou que o veículo adulterado tinha registro de roubo ou furto.

O homem preso, os veículos e as drogas apreendidas foram encaminhados à Polícia Federal para os procedimentos legais.

articles.title: Dia Nacional do Livro em Jundiaí: Estação terá livros grátis  | G1
articles.standfirst: Ação que acontece nesta quinta-feira (29) irá oferecer aos passageiros da Linha 7-Rubi opções de obras destinadas ao público infantojuvenil ou adulto; retirada ficará disponível das 10h às 15h.
articles.summary: Ação no Dia Nacional do Livro em Jundiaí distribui obras gratuitas na estação da Linha 7-Rubi para passageiros de todas as idades nesta quinta-feira (29).
articles.body:
Estação Ferroviária de Jundiaí — Foto: Divulgação

Durante o Dia Nacional do Livro , comemorado nesta quinta-feira (29), os passageiros de trem em Jundiaí (SP) podem aproveitar a passagem pela estação para retirar, gratuitamente, um novo livro para leitura. A iniciativa faz parte do projeto "Leia-me e me esqueça por aí", promovido pelo Grupo Projetos de Leitura, em parceria com a TIC Trens.

A ação vai disponibilizar 2,5 mil exemplares de obras do autor paulista Laé de Souza. A retirada dos livros ocorre das 10h às 15h.

Os passageiros tem duas opções de obras de literatura para escolher levar para casa. Ao público infantojuvenil o livro "Um trânsito tranquilo para todos" conta a história de um grupo de jovens que inicia uma campanha de conscientização sobre trânsito.

Já para quem se interessar por uma literatura mais madura, o autor disponibilizou a obra "Vivos, vivos, vivos!", que narra a história de um personagem que incentiva os amigos a realizar sonhos que ficaram para trás.

Laé de Souza estará presente no evento para acompanhar a equipe, autografar suas obras e conversar com os leitores. Para ele, a leitura de um livro é a abertura de um novo mundo. "A leitura nos faz refletir e abre possibilidades de transformação”, destacou.

Escritor Laé de Souza criou o grupo “Projetos de Leitura” que atua em todo o país — Foto: Divulgação

A proposta do projeto de incentivo à leitura é que, ao terminarem a leitura de um livro, as pessoas o disponibilizem para um próximo leitor, doando a obra ou a deixando "por aí".

A programação segue na sexta-feira (30) na estação de Franco da Rocha, também da Linha 7-Rubi, com o mesmo horário de funcionamento.

articles.title: José Crespo é investigado por fake news contra Lula em Sorocaba | G1
articles.standfirst: Promotoria mandou apurar crime eleitoral em post que simulava matéria do portal para associar uma fala à Lula; checagem do Fato ou Fake apontou adulterações e político diz não se lembrar.
articles.summary: José Crespo é alvo de inquérito por compartilhar fake news contra Lula; ex-prefeito de Sorocaba alega não se lembrar de postagem que simulava site de notícias.
articles.body:
Ex-prefeito José Crespo divulgou fake news sobre Lula — Foto: Redes sociais / Reprodução

O Ministério Público do Estado de São Paulo (MP-SP) determinou a abertura de um inquérito policial contra o ex-prefeito de Sorocaba (SP), José Antonio Caldini Crespo, por compartilhar nas redes sociais uma notícia falsa sobre o presidente Lula (PT). A decisão foi despachada pela promotora Cristina Palma após denúncia de crime eleitoral durante o 2º turno das Eleições 2026.

A postagem investigada foi ao ar em 7 de outubro no perfil oficial de Crespo no Facebook e continuava ativa na rede até a noite desta quarta-feira (28). Na ocasião, o político reproduziu uma montagem que imita uma reportagem do g1 e exibe o título "Lula: 'Mulher é que nem milho, nasceu pelinho já pode comer'".

A publicação do ex-prefeito foi feita no Facebook e recebeu o engajamento de mais de mil reações, comentários e compartilhamentos. Além da imagem de uma suposta manchete do g1, Crespo incluiu um comentário: "Evidente pedofilia e ninfomania".

O caso foi denunciado inicialmente como uma Notícia de Fato envolvendo crime eleitoral, pois a notícia falsa relacionava a imagem do então candidato a reeleição da presidência da República, Lula (PT). Na decisão de encaminhamento do caso para investigação criminal, a promotora Cristina Palma declarou:

"Trata-se de uma representação para apuração de crime ocorrido em véspera de eleição nacional, consistente na publicação de uma notícia em internet, cujo teor de veracidade merece ser apurado, tendo em vista que é atribuída ao portal g1, mas a qual o denunciante informa suspeita de inveracidade".

Ao g1 , Crespo disse que não se lembra de ter feito a publicação e disse quando for notificado, poderá justificar.

É #FAKE que Lula disse que 'mulher é que nem milho' — Foto: Reprodução

O g1 nunca publicou uma reportagem com esse título ou conteúdo: trata-se de uma montagem. Lula também não fez a declaração atribuída a ele: não há qualquer registro de um pronunciamento com esse teor, publicações nas redes sociais oficiais do presidente ou nos canais de comunicação do governo federal.

A montagem também tem inconsistências em relação ao site verdade do g1 :

a letra do título fake é maior do que a tipografia verdadeira;

a versão mentirosa não exibe o campo de autor;

articles.title: Wi-Fi gratuito no CRAS Amapá: 7 unidades terão internet rápida | G1
articles.standfirst: Investimento do Governo Federal vai beneficiar equipes e famílias cadastradas nos CRAS. Primeira etapa de instalações deve ser concluída até abril de 2027.
articles.summary: Com investimento federal, o Wi-Fi gratuito no CRAS Amapá terá 300 Mbps em sete unidades para agilizar o CadÚnico e o acesso da população a serviços digitais.
articles.body:
Amapá terá Wi-Fi gratuito e internet rápida em 7 unidades do CRAS para facilitar acessos. — Foto: Ludymila Maia/OCA

Sete Centros de Referência de Assistência Social (CRAS) no Amapá vão receber internet de alta velocidade e sinal de Wi-Fi gratuito até outubro de 2027. A informação foi divulgada nesta quarta-feira (28), pelo Governo Federal.

A iniciativa do Ministério das Comunicações conta com um investimento de R$ 224 mil do Governo Federal e busca agilizar o atendimento às famílias, além de facilitar o acesso a serviços públicos digitais.

O cronograma de instalação prevê que metade das unidades receba a conexão até abril de 2027, enquanto o restante será contemplado até outubro do mesmo ano.

“Queremos dar melhores condições de trabalho aos profissionais da assistência social e facilitar o acesso das famílias a serviços públicos, benefícios e oportunidades. A inclusão digital precisa chegar a todos os cantos do Brasil, inclusive às comunidades [...] que mais precisam desses serviços”, afirma o ministro das Comunicações, Frederico de Siqueira Filho.

Agilidade nos serviços e inclusão digital

Com o novo sinal, as equipes técnicas dos centros poderão atualizar os dados do Cadastro Único (CadÚnico) e consultar sistemas estaduais e federais com mais rapidez, reduzindo o tempo de espera no atendimento presencial.

A população que frequenta os prédios também poderá se conectar à rede via Wi-Fi. A estrutura usará tecnologia de fibra óptica, com velocidade de 300 Megabits por segundo (Mbps) em cada unidade.

Com o acesso livre, os moradores poderão consultar a situação de benefícios sociais, inscrever-se em cursos de capacitação profissional e buscar vagas de emprego pela internet.

Os recursos para a expansão da rede são provenientes do Fundo de Universalização dos Serviços de Telecomunicações (Fust), voltado para a ampliação do acesso digital em prédios e equipamentos públicos de todo o país.

articles.title: BH institui programa para regularizar dívidas municipais com desconto | G1
articles.standfirst: 'Regulariza BH' permite acordos para débitos tributários e não tributários com a prefeitura. Regras incluem negociação de juros e multas e uso de precatórios para abatimentos.
articles.summary: 'Regulariza BH' permite acordos para débitos tributários e não tributários com a prefeitura. Regras incluem negociação de juros e multas e uso de precatórios para abatimentos.
articles.body:
Sede da Prefeitura de Belo Horizonte — Foto: Rodrigo Clemente/PBH

A Prefeitura de Belo Horizonte instituiu nesta quarta-feira (28) o programa " Regulariza BH ", que permitirá a negociação de dívidas municipais, sejam elas tributárias ou não. A lei que implementa a medida foi sancionada pelo prefeito Álvaro Damião (União Brasil) e publicada no Diário Oficial do Município (DOM).

Entre as possibilidades previstas estão descontos em multas , juros e encargos , parcelamento em até 120 meses e redução de até 65% do total dos créditos negociados. A iniciativa, no entanto, impede a redução do valor original da dívida e prevê um acréscimo de 10% sobre a quantia atualizada ( leia mais abaixo ).

Ainda conforme a lei, os descontos não serão concedidos indistintamente. Eles poderão ser aplicados a multas, juros e encargos de créditos considerados de difícil recuperação ou irrecuperáveis, de acordo com critérios que serão definidos pelas autoridades municipais.

O programa deve abranger débitos que não chegaram à Justiça, aqueles discutidos administrativamente e dívidas já judicializadas. Empresas em recuperação judicial, liquidação ou falência estão entre aquelas que poderão ser beneficiadas.

Embora a lei já esteja em vigor, algumas regras práticas ainda serão detalhadas pela prefeitura. O texto que deu origem à medida é de autoria do vereador Wagner Ferreira (REDE).

Entenda, a partir dos pontos abaixo, tudo sobre o "Regulariza BH" :

O "Regulariza BH" prevê duas formas principais de negociação:

Uma delas será individual , a partir de uma proposta específica e fundamentada. Neste caso, deverão ser considerados fatores como a capacidade de pagamento do contribuinte, o histórico da dívida e a perspectiva de recuperação do dinheiro pela prefeitura.

A outra modalidade será por adesão . Neste formato, a prefeitura publicará um edital com as regras, condições, descontos, prazos e formas de pagamento. Quem aderir terá que aceitar todas as condições estabelecidas.

A lei determina ainda que contribuintes em situações equivalentes tenham tratamento igual. Caso uma negociação individual conceda determinado tratamento a um contribuinte, outros que estejam em situação fática e jurídica idêntica poderão solicitar as mesmas condições.

Além dos descontos e prazos especiais, os acordos poderão envolver:

oferecimento, substituição ou alienação de garantias;

uso de precatórios ou créditos reconhecidos por decisão judicial definitiva para amortizar dívida, multa e juros;

combinação de mais de uma dessas alternativas.

A impossibilidade de apresentar garantia, por si só, não impede a negociação.

A lei estabelece que uma negociação não permitirá reduzir o valor original do débito. Os abatimentos poderão atingir multas, juros e outros encargos.

Além disso, a redução não poderá ultrapassar 65% do valor total dos créditos incluídos na negociação, e o prazo para quitação será de, no máximo, 120 meses (dez anos).

No caso de controvérsias tributárias consideradas relevantes e que atinjam um conjunto maior de contribuintes, a Secretaria Municipal de Fazenda e a Procuradoria-Geral do Município poderão lançar editais específicos de negociação.

A legislação estabelece algumas restrições. Não poderão ser reduzidas, por exemplo, multas aplicadas em casos nos quais tenham sido constatados dolo, fraude ou simulação.

Também não poderão receber desconto determinados débitos de Imposto Sobre Serviços de Qualquer Natureza (ISSQN) retido na fonte e não recolhido dentro do prazo. A exceção ocorre quando esses débitos já estiverem inscritos em dívida ativa.

Também ficam fora dos descontos os créditos decorrentes da legislação de trânsito especificada pela própria lei.

A transação também é proibida para o chamado devedor contumaz, cuja definição dependerá de legislação específica.

Para fechar a negociação, o devedor terá que assumir uma série de compromissos. Entre eles está a desistência de recursos administrativos relacionados aos débitos incluídos no acordo.

Nos processos judiciais, também será necessário renunciar às alegações que sustentam a discussão dos créditos negociados e pedir a extinção da ação correspondente.

Depois de aceita, a negociação representa uma confissão irrevogável da dívida. O débito somente será considerado extinto após o cumprimento integral das condições do acordo.

A simples apresentação de uma proposta também não suspende automaticamente a cobrança da dívida nem uma eventual execução fiscal. A suspensão do processo judicial poderá ocorrer por acordo entre as partes nas hipóteses previstas na legislação.

A transação poderá ser cancelada caso o contribuinte descumpra as condições estabelecidas ou pratique atos para esvaziar o patrimônio e impedir a cobrança.

Também estão entre os motivos para rescisão situações como fraude, simulação, corrupção relacionada à formação do acordo e falência ou liquidação da empresa.

Antes da rescisão, o devedor deverá ser notificado e terá 30 dias para contestar a decisão. Se o problema puder ser corrigido, a lei permite a regularização dentro desse período.

Se o acordo for rescindido, os benefícios serão cancelados e a dívida voltará a ser cobrada integralmente, descontando-se aquilo que já tiver sido pago.

Além disso, quem tiver uma transação rescindida ficará dois anos sem poder fazer um novo acordo pelo "Regulariza BH", mesmo para outras dívidas.

A nova legislação também determina a incidência de um acréscimo de 10% sobre o valor total atualizado da dívida nos créditos abrangidos pela norma, inclusive nas negociações.

Metade desse valor será destinada a uma conta específica a título de honorários advocatícios. A outra metade irá para o Fundo de Modernização e Aprimoramento da Administração Tributária do Município (FMAATM), conforme as regras previstas na lei.

Embora a lei já esteja em vigor, parte das regras práticas do "Regulariza BH" ainda precisará ser detalhada pela prefeitura.

A Secretaria Municipal de Fazenda e a Procuradoria-Geral do Município serão responsáveis, conforme o tipo de débito, por estabelecer critérios como a classificação das dívidas de difícil recuperação, condições para concessão dos descontos, exigência de entrada ou garantias e documentos necessários.

Nos casos de adesão, os editais deverão informar quais dívidas poderão entrar na negociação, os descontos oferecidos, os prazos de pagamento e o período disponível para adesão.

articles.title: Plans to reopen Surrey theatre overcome major hurdle on roof work
articles.summary: Redhill's Harlequin Theatre remains closed, years after unsafe crumbly concrete was detected.
articles.body:
Plans to remove and replace a Surrey theatre's roof are due to be considered to help reopen the venue.

Redhill's popular Harlequin Theatre closed in 2023 after it was discovered that unsafe crumbly RAAC concrete lining the building could collapse without warning.

The site has remained closed since with delays and rising costs pushing back its scheduled reopening date.

However, the Local Democracy Reporting Service (LDRS) reports a major hurdle now looks set to be overcome as Reigate and Banstead Borough Council's planning committee has been recommended to approve sorting out the roof.

The plans, if greenlit, will also install new electrics and power in the building.

An official reopening is to be confirmed – although it is hoped visitors will finally be allowed to return to the theatre in 2028.

Harlequin Theatre was built in the 1980s as part of a wider block that includes the Belfry Shopping Centre.

It will remain closed until all safety work is completed and the fit-out finished.

This later stage could further delay the theatre's reopening as the new operators will need to approve its new-look interior.

"These works will ensure that the theatre remains safe, functional and fit for operational use," say the planning papers.

"The proposed works would significantly contribute to the overall aim of improving the integrity of the building, making it safe to occupy again, leading to the eventual reopening."

Consultation letters were sent to neighbouring properties in September, receiving no objections or comments, according to the LDRS.

The next scheduled planning committee is due to take place on 28 October.

articles.title: 'Huntingdon train attacker 'asked man do you want to die?'
articles.summary: Anthony Williams denies 14 counts of attempted murder, including 10 on a train in Cambridgeshire.
articles.body:
Train passengers fled "in sheer terror" from a knife attacker who asked one victim "do you want to die?", a trial has heard.

Anthony Williams, 33, is accused of attempting to murder 10 passengers and staff on a train that had to make an emergency stop in Huntingdon, Cambridgeshire, on 1 November 2025. He is also accused of trying to kill three people in Peterborough the day before and then a boy at a London railway station.

Opening the prosecution case at Cambridge Crown Court, Christopher Paxton KC said that of those on the train "some stood tall, to protect others trying to de-escalate his rampage".

Williams, of Langford Road in Peterborough, denies 14 counts of attempted murder.

Williams is accused of attempting to murder Jonathan Gjoshe, Sachin Balakrishnan, David Presland, Scott Bletcher, Scott Green, Kevin Deely, Stephen Crean, Raza Aslam, Michael Paffett and Samir Zitouni on the train between Peterborough and Huntingdon on that Saturday evening.

He is also accused of attempting to murder a 14-year-old boy and Dawid Taborski on a footbridge near Henry Penn Walk in Peterborough on 31 October, and William Ogelby at Railworld car park in the city shortly afterwards.

Williams was then seen swigging from a bottle of alcohol outside Ritzy Barber Shop in Fletton in Peterborough, before going into the shop brandishing a knife.

The jury heard he then travelled to east London, where he stabbed a 17-year-old on a Docklands Light Railway train at Pontoon Dock in Silvertown in the early hours of 1 November.

During that attack, jurors were told a witness said she heard the defendant repeatedly say: "Are you trying to beef with the devil?"

Paxton said: "Across the Halloween weekend last year, to the many people he encountered the defendant Anthony Williams posed a dangerous threat, marauding through towns and cities, on streets and trains alike, armed with a knife.

"He stabbed many, seeking to end their lives with deadly intention, striking out at them when they were defenceless and in fear."

The trial has been told that whether Williams carried out the attacks was not in question, but jurors must consider whether he intended to kill those individuals when he carried out the attacks.

Paxton said Williams had "brought terror" to train passengers after boarding at Peterborough, "which resulted in them fleeing and some fighting for their lives".

"In the face of that threat and the defendant's sheer brutality some stood tall to protect others trying to de-escalate his rampage, defending themselves and putting themselves in harm's way to protect strangers," he said.

He added that some had locked themselves in toilets, and others showed "extraordinary bravery" in trying to fend Williams off by grabbing items such as a toaster from the buffet car to protect themselves.

Samir Zitouni, a member of the train's crew, tried to use a frying pan to stop Williams, but was stabbed multiple times, the court heard.

Jurors were told they would see footage from the train involving one of the victims, 73-year-old Presland, who the court heard was attacked after he fell to the ground.

Paxton said jurors would be able to see a "hand come up from the floor of the train - that was Mr Presland. You will see above him, all in black, the defendant wielding the knife".

He said Presland had been "defenceless and powerless" and "was no threat to Mr Williams".

One of the victims, jurors heard, "tried to grab the knife blade itself", while another was stabbed in the head and stomach.

Paxton said one of the passengers, Crean, decided "he had to try to stop it" and "launched himself towards and at Mr Williams".

Paxton said Williams asked Crean "do you want to die?".

"We say [that was] clear evidence of the defendant's intention to kill, as was the use of the knife to stab so many," the prosecuting counsel said.

"The fact that some of the victims had minor cuts or wounds, or some had no injuries at all, does not mean there was no intention to kill."

Paxton said "the attack was stopped only by the quick thinking of the train driver", with the London-bound LNER service making an unscheduled stop at Huntingdon - the next station south from Peterborough.

He said "even if the defendant viewed them as the devil, as he suggested to [the 17-year-old] earlier that day, it does not give the defendant, Mr Williams, any lawful reason to attack any one of those passengers on that LNER train".

The jury, consisting of three women and nine men, were told by the judge Mr Justice Calver that Williams was appearing via videolink from Rampton Hospital in Nottinghamshire, rather than sitting in the dock.

He said it would "best ensure his effective participation in the trial", and would avoid a four-hour round trip to court.

articles.title: Ethiopia receives 12 Russian Su-35 jets, plans S-400 acquisition
articles.summary: PM Abiy Ahmed makes announcement during a Moscow summit as Ethiopia battles armed groups in Tigray and Amhara.
articles.body:
Ethiopia has received 12 Russian Su-35 fighter jets and will also acquire four S-400 air defence batteries, Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has announced.

Abiy made the announcement on X on Wednesday during a visit to Moscow for the two-day Russia-Africa Summit, where Russia is seeking closer security and economic ties with African countries.

The acquisition comes as Ethiopian forces fight renewed battles with rebels in northern Tigray and a separate rebellion in the neighbouring Amhara region.

The prime minister said the warplanes had arrived a year earlier than expected under an existing agreement with Moscow, thanking Russian President Vladimir Putin for helping speed up the delivery.

He gave no date for the arrival of the S-400 batteries, designed to shoot down aircraft and missiles.

Abiy said on Wednesday that the new equipment would strengthen Ethiopia’s ability to “preemptively deter aggression”.

In a second X post later that day, he described the jets as newly deployed and said they would defend Ethiopian airspace.

The announcement is the latest sign of Russia ‘s growing military partnership with Ethiopia, following a series of agreements in recent years.

The two governments signed a military cooperation agreement in Addis Ababa in July 2021 aimed at improving the Ethiopian armed forces’ training and technology.

In January, defence publication Janes reported that Ethiopia had displayed newly acquired Russian Yak-130 advanced jet trainers during celebrations marking its air force’s 90th anniversary.

Russia supplied 15 percent of Africa’s imports of major weapons between 2021 and 2025, making it the continent’s third-largest supplier, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute.

Moscow has sought closer military and economic ties with African countries while facing Western sanctions over its war in Ukraine.

The Russia-Africa Summit, which began on Wednesday, brings African leaders together for talks on trade, investment and security.

The announcement follows a major shift in the fighting in Tigray, where government troops and allied forces entered the regional capital Mekelle on October 4 after fighters from the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) withdrew.

The TPLF, an armed group that previously governed the region, has suffered further territorial losses as government forces advanced into other towns.

Addis Ababa has since appointed a six-month caretaker administration for Tigray, but the fighting has not stopped.

A TPLF commander called for continued resistance in a television broadcast last week, while the group has also claimed attacks against government-aligned troops in northwestern Tigray on Wednesday.

The renewed war has effectively undone a peace agreement signed in Pretoria, South Africa, in November 2022 that ended two years of fighting, which researchers at Belgium’s Ghent University estimate killed about 500,000 civilians.

Government forces are also battling Fano, an Amhara armed group that has been fighting federal troops since 2023.

articles.title: Election Day storm could impact voter turnout in key midterm races in the central US
articles.summary: A storm tracking through the central United States on Election Day could soak voters.
articles.body: A soggy storm will track through the central United States on Election Day and could influence voter turnout for key races in the region. Exactly which races will see rain next Tuesday is still a toss-up, with questions remaining about the storm’s exact location and strength. This is normal for a forecast nearly a week away. We’ll know more by this weekend, but for now, it’s looking like Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, Ohio and Texas might have to contend with wet conditions. The rain will be a turnout factor in those states and for others in the central US who aren’t among the more than 35 million people who have already cast ballots through early voting. Rainfall and other active weather tend to suppress voter turnout while sunshine has the opposite effect, multiple studies have found. The big forecast picture Tuesday’s rain threat could extend from parts of the Great Lakes and Upper Midwest to the western Gulf Coast, but exactly where the storm sets up will mean the difference between staying dry, a washout or nuisance showers. Gusty winds could accompany the rain in the Midwest and Plains, and strong thunderstorms are possible on the storm’s southern side. Dry weather will likely bookend the storm along much of the East Coast and in the West. The only exception is coastal areas of the Mid-Atlantic and Southeast where nuisance showers can’t be completely ruled out yet. One forecast is for sure: There will be no need to bundle up. High temperatures in most of the nation’s eastern half are forecast to be 5 to 15 degrees Fahrenheit above average. Only the Southwest will have temperatures tilting a bit cooler than average.
